products.name: Rose Tea
products.description: A fragrant blend of Assam tea and real rose petals. Smooth, floral and calming.
products.ingredients: CTC Black Tea (Camellia sinensis), Rose Petals (Rosa spp.)
products.benefit: A delicate floral cup for relaxing moments and gentle period-day self-care.

products.name: Cinnamon Tea
products.description: Rich Assam tea with warm Kerala cinnamon. A cup that brings people together.
products.ingredients: Assam CTC Black Tea (Camellia sinensis), Natural Cinnamon
products.benefit: Cinnamon may help ease mild menstrual cramps and support digestive comfort.

products.name: Elaichi Tea
products.description: Assam CTC with green cardamom. Strong, aromatic and perfect for milk chai.
products.ingredients: Assam CTC Black Tea (Camellia sinensis), Cardamom (Elettaria cardamomum)
brew_steps: Bring 1.5 to 2 cups of water to a boil.
Let it boil for 3 to 5 minutes.
Add milk and sugar to taste. Boil 1 to 2 minutes and enjoy.
products.benefit: Fragrant cardamom is traditionally used to soothe digestive discomfort.

products.name: Masala Tea
products.description: Assam CTC with whole Kerala spices: cinnamon, clove, cardamom, pepper and mace. Our everyday masala chai.
products.ingredients: Assam CTC Black Tea (Camellia sinensis), whole spices: cinnamon, clove, cardamom, black pepper, star anise and mace.
products.benefit: A comforting spiced tea that may ease bloating and provide warmth during your period.

products.name: Ginger Tea

products.ingredients: Assam CTC Black Tea (Camellia sinensis), Dry Ginger (Zingiber officinale)
products.benefit: Ginger may help ease menstrual cramps, nausea and occasional bloating.
